title: A painting becomes a system
asset_strategy: Lead with the source painting, move into reconstruction evidence, end on the garment as a desirable worn fragment. Use Adrift painting and 4DRFT design files for origin and system language, then JRR_4001.jpg and JRR_4046.jpg for body-led product proof. Keep every frame sparse, archive-like, and premium.

slides.headline: SEVEN DESIGNS.
slides.notes: Full-frame source image. Bone field, quiet labels, immediate art authority.

slides.headline: CAPTURE
slides.notes: Macro crop with technical tension. Treat texture like evidence.

slides.headline: RECONSTRUCT
slides.notes: Pair source logic with reconstruction geometry. Stark, measured, minimal.

slides.headline: EXTRACTED
slides.notes: Use a cropped plate feel. Negative space first, object second.

slides.headline: WORN
slides.notes: Styled body, oversized silhouette, confident motion. Make the garment feel wanted.

slides.headline: OBJECT
slides.notes: Close product hero with street/studio energy. Quiet finish, strong desirability.

image_concepts.name: Canvas to Body
image_concepts.brief: Show the full transformation arc in one fashion-led sequence: source painting, scan evidence, reconstructed garment, worn fragment in motion.
image_concepts.prompt: Premium fashion campaign source image, image-only, no readable text, no typography, no logos. A restrained art-translation streetwear scene that makes a painted artwork feel extracted into clothing. Start with a bone-background technical archive feel, then transition through optical scan evidence and reconstruction logic into a worn oversized garment on a real body. The garment should feel desirable first: premium streetwear silhouette, graphic placement, textile texture, confident posture, candid motion. Include city/studio/gallery context with concrete, glass, metal, shadow, and sparse near-black and oxidized red accents. Use the painting as source material through crop, projection, reflection, or overlay evidence. Clean, minimal, mysterious, premium, fashion-editorial, social-follow-worthy.

image_concepts.name: Reconstruction Hero
image_concepts.brief: Create a centered product hero that still reads like an archive artifact reconstructed from canvas data.
image_concepts.prompt: High-end editorial product hero, image-only, no readable text, no fake typography. A premium oversized streetwear garment presented as a reconstructed fragment from an artwork archive. Styled on body in a gallery-studio-city hybrid environment with concrete floor, glass reflections, brushed metal edges, near-black shadows, bone-toned negative space, and oxidized red trace accents. The garment should dominate the frame with tactile textile detail, confident stance, subtle motion blur, and fashion-campaign energy. Visually suggest technical reconstruction through crop marks, scanline presence, coordinate-system composition, and layered source evidence without adding any embedded text. Minimal, sharp, premium, desirably wearable.

image_concepts.name: Fragment in Motion
image_concepts.brief: Make the wearable piece feel alive in motion, like an object moving through the city with art-origin residue.
image_concepts.prompt: Cinematic streetwear fashion campaign image, image-only, no readable text, no logos, no graffiti. A model in an oversized silhouette wears a reconstructed fragment garment while moving through a muted city/studio/gallery context. Show candid motion, strong body language, textile weight, and product-as-identity. The art-origin story should appear as source evidence projected or reflected nearby, like a scan-derived archive residue. Palette must stay premium and restrained: bone background tones, near-black, oxidized red, muted technical neutrals, with source-art color only from the painting material. Include concrete, glass, and metal textures, sparse composition, clean negative space, and a confident, aspirational feel that sits between art archive and premium streetwear campaign.
